about.title: GUIDANCE OF A TRUE CHAMPION
about.subtitle: Mentored by Ustaad Abu Huraira — Ex Mr. Kasur & General Secretary of Kasur Bodybuilding Association.
about.p1: For over two decades, Abu Huraira World Gym Fitness Center has stood as the foundation of authentic strength culture in Kasur. Located in Kot Murad Khan, our institution has trained everyday working people, aspiring youth, and regional bodybuilding champions alike.
about.p2: Where fitness meets community: we believe in more than just workouts — we believe in empowering you to achieve your fitness goals in a supportive and motivating environment. Under the personal oversight of Coach Abu Huraira, you receive customized biomechanical advice tailored to your capabilities and lifelong health goals.
about.bullet1Desc: Over 20 years producing district and provincial physique medalists.
about.bullet2Desc: Meticulously maintained equipment, sanitized gym floors, and fresh air patio.
about.bullet3Desc: A respectful, family-like atmosphere where every member is encouraged.
